import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar.Core

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
open Set Function Manifold
open scoped Manifold ContDiff Topology

/-- The fixed model has exactly the geometric half-space, with its usual interior/frontier. -/
theorem halfSpaceModel_range_geometry {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] :
    range (halfSpaceModel V) = {z : V × ℝ | 0 ≤ z.2} ∧
    interior (range (halfSpaceModel V)) = {z : V × ℝ | 0 < z.2} ∧
    frontier (range (halfSpaceModel V)) = {z : V × ℝ | z.2 = 0} :=
/- SWARM_PROOF_BEGIN -/
by
  sorry
/- SWARM_PROOF_END -/
end PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
hint: Unfold only as needed: forward map is Subtype.val, range is univ × Ici 0. Use product interior/closure and real interval geometry. This lemma identifies the shared model for ALL points; clamping outside the range must never be claimed smooth.

/-- Translation of ambient coordinates preserves the original smooth atlas. -/
theorem translated_chart_mem_maximalAtlas
    {E N : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E N] [IsManifold (𝓘(ℝ, E)) ∞ N]
    (a : OpenPartialHomeomorph N E)
    (ha : a ∈ IsManifold.maximalAtlas (𝓘(ℝ, E)) ∞ N) (v : E) :
    a.trans (Homeomorph.addRight v).toOpenPartialHomeomorph ∈
      IsManifold.maximalAtlas (𝓘(ℝ, E)) ∞ N :=
/- SWARM_PROOF_BEGIN -/
by
  sorry
/- SWARM_PROOF_END -/
end PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
hint: Use mem_maximalAtlas_of_contMDiffOn. Translation and its inverse are globally ContDiff hence ContMDiff. Compose on the exact partial source/target. Use a.contMDiffOn from maximalAtlas membership. Do not change the ambient charted structure.

import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar.Core
import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar.TranslateChart

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
open Set Function Manifold
open scoped Manifold ContDiff Topology

/-- Every interior point admits a smooth local set model for the SAME corners model as the boundary. -/
theorem interior_point_has_ambient_model
    {E H N : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E N]
    [IsManifold (𝓘(ℝ, E)) ∞ N] (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H)
    {K : Set N} {p : N} (hp : p ∈ interior K) :
    ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph N E,
      p ∈ e.source ∧ e ∈ IsManifold.maximalAtlas (𝓘(ℝ, E)) ∞ N ∧
      e.IsImage K (range I) :=
/- SWARM_PROOF_BEGIN -/
by
  sorry
/- SWARM_PROOF_END -/
end PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
hint: Choose v in interior(range I), translate chartAt E p by v-chartAt E p p using the integrated translated-chart lemma. Restrict its source to interior K and the preimage of interior(range I). This restricted neighborhood contains p and is open by OpenPartialHomeomorph.isOpen_inter_preimage. Both sides of IsImage hold everywhere on the restricted source. Use StructureGroupoid.restr_mem_maximalAtlas for the open restriction. A local target does NOT need to be the entire half-space.

/-- The normalized restriction of an actual full open collar is an open embedding onto its target. -/
theorem collarRestriction_isOpenEmbedding
    {X N : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace N]
    (F : OpenPartialHomeomorph (X × ℝ) N)
    (hsource : F.source = (univ : Set X) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    Topology.IsOpenEmbedding (collarRestriction F) ∧ range (collarRestriction F) = F.target :=
/- SWARM_PROOF_BEGIN -/
by
  sorry
/- SWARM_PROOF_END -/
end PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
hint: Use F.isOpenEmbedding_restrict on its source, composed with the explicit homeomorphism X × NeckParameter -> F.source. Mathlib has Homeomorph.Set.prod, subtype-product homeomorphisms, and Homeomorph.setCongr. Alternatively construct the explicit homeomorphism with correct induced topologies. Surjectivity onto F.target follows from F.symm, map_target and right_inv. The statement must also work for empty X; avoid introducing a Nonempty assumption.

import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar.Core

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
open Set Function Manifold
open scoped Manifold ContDiff Topology

/-- Cross-section chart times the real coordinate is smooth with smooth inverse,
using a vector-space product target rather than silently identifying model type tags. -/
theorem product_chart_contMDiffOn {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [ChartedSpace V X]
    [IsManifold (𝓘(ℝ, V)) ∞ X]
    (a : OpenPartialHomeomorph X V)
    (ha : a ∈ IsManifold.maximalAtlas (𝓘(ℝ, V)) ∞ X) :
    let b := a.prod (Homeomorph.refl ℝ).toOpenPartialHomeomorph
    ContMDiffOn ((𝓘(ℝ, V)).prod (𝓘(ℝ, ℝ))) (𝓘(ℝ, V × ℝ)) ∞ b b.source ∧
    ContMDiffOn (𝓘(ℝ, V × ℝ)) ((𝓘(ℝ, V)).prod (𝓘(ℝ, ℝ))) ∞ b.symm b.target :=
/- SWARM_PROOF_BEGIN -/
by
  sorry
/- SWARM_PROOF_END -/
end PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
hint: From ha get smoothness of a and a.symm. Compose each with projections, using correct source sets. Forward pair uses ContMDiffOn.prodMk_space into the vector-space model; inverse pair uses ContMDiffOn.prodMk into the product manifold. On the vector-space domain the projections are ContDiff hence ContMDiff. Do NOT change existing model structures or hide type-tag mismatches with new instances.

import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar.Core

/-- Actual smooth collar coordinates belong to the ambient smooth maximal atlas. -/
theorem collarCoordinates_mem_maximalAtlas {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    {X N : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace N]
    [ChartedSpace V X] [ChartedSpace (V × ℝ) N]
    [IsManifold (𝓘(ℝ, V)) ∞ X] [IsManifold (𝓘(ℝ, V × ℝ)) ∞ N]
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph ((𝓘(ℝ, V)).prod (𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)))
      (𝓘(ℝ, V × ℝ)) (X × ℝ) N ∞)
    (a : OpenPartialHomeomorph X V)
    (ha : a ∈ IsManifold.maximalAtlas (𝓘(ℝ, V)) ∞ X) :
    collarCoordinates Φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph a ∈
      IsManifold.maximalAtlas (𝓘(ℝ, V × ℝ)) ∞ N :=
/- SWARM_PROOF_BEGIN -/
by
  sorry
/- SWARM_PROOF_END -/
end PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
hint: Compose the supplied partial diffeomorphism inverse with the integrated product-chart forward map; compose the product-chart inverse with Φ for the inverse direction. Use exact trans_source/trans_target and MapsTo. Then mem_maximalAtlas_of_contMDiffOn. No source-strip assumption is needed for smoothness itself.

import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar.Core
import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar.Restriction
import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar.HalfSpaceRange

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
open Set Function Manifold
open scoped Manifold ContDiff Topology

/-- Exact zero-contact collar coordinates straighten the actual complementary closure. -/
theorem collarCoordinates_component_geometry {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    {X N : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace N] [PreconnectedSpace X]
    (F : OpenPartialHomeomorph (X × ℝ) N)
    (hsource : F.source = (univ : Set X) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    {C : Set N} (hside : ∀ z ∈ F.source, F z ∈ C ↔ z.2 ≤ 0)
    {p : N} {x : X} (hx : F (x, 0) ∈ frontier (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p))
    (a : OpenPartialHomeomorph X V) :
    (∀ z : X × NeckParameter, z.1 ∈ a.source →
      collarRestriction F z ∈ (collarCoordinates F a).source ∧
      collarCoordinates F a (collarRestriction F z) = (a z.1, (z.2 : ℝ))) ∧
    (collarCoordinates F a).IsImage (closure (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p))
      (range (halfSpaceModel V)) :=
/- SWARM_PROOF_BEGIN -/
by
  sorry
/- SWARM_PROOF_END -/
end PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
hint: Use integrated collarRestriction_isOpenEmbedding and halfSpaceModel_range_geometry. The restricted side hypothesis is inherited from hsource. Apply existing oneSidedCollar_mem_closure_component_iff_nonneg to the restriction. For y in the coordinate source, z=F.symm y is in the strip; represent it as X × NeckParameter, use F.right_inv and the explicit coordinate formula. For forward coordinates use F.left_inv on the strip. The target map is the DEFINED collarCoordinates, not an arbitrary existential homeomorphism.

import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar.Core

/-- A genuine smooth full collar supplies the exact ambient smooth model at a contacted center. -/
theorem smoothCollar_center_has_ambient_model {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    {X N : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace N]
    [ChartedSpace V X] [ChartedSpace (V × ℝ) N]
    [IsManifold (𝓘(ℝ, V)) ∞ X] [IsManifold (𝓘(ℝ, V × ℝ)) ∞ N] [PreconnectedSpace X]
    (Φ : PartialDiffeomorph ((𝓘(ℝ, V)).prod (𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)))
      (𝓘(ℝ, V × ℝ)) (X × ℝ) N ∞)
    (hsource : Φ.source = (univ : Set X) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    {C : Set N} (hside : ∀ z ∈ Φ.source, Φ z ∈ C ↔ z.2 ≤ 0)
    {p : N} {x : X} (hx : Φ (x, 0) ∈ frontier (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p)) :
    ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph N (V × ℝ),
      Φ (x, 0) ∈ e.source ∧
      e ∈ IsManifold.maximalAtlas (𝓘(ℝ, V × ℝ)) ∞ N ∧
      e.IsImage (closure (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p)) (range (halfSpaceModel V)) :=
/- SWARM_PROOF_BEGIN -/
by
  sorry
/- SWARM_PROOF_END -/
end PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
hint: Choose a = chartAt V x and e = collarCoordinates Φ.toOpenPartialHomeomorph a. Combine integrated geometry and smoothness. The center is the actual point Φ(x,0); its source membership must be proved, not assumed. This closes the formerly missing smooth-compatibility bridge for a supplied genuine smooth collar.

import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar.Core
import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar.Restriction
import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.DomainAtlas.CollarClosureFrontier

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
open Set Function Manifold
open scoped Manifold ContDiff Topology

/-- Full smooth collars covering the actual frontier force regular openness of the complement. -/
theorem smoothCollar_cover_regularOpen {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    {X N : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace N]
    [ChartedSpace V X] [ChartedSpace (V × ℝ) N]
    [IsManifold (𝓘(ℝ, V)) ∞ X] [IsManifold (𝓘(ℝ, V × ℝ)) ∞ N] [PreconnectedSpace X] [LocallyConnectedSpace N]
    {C : Set N} (hC : IsClosed C) {p : N}
    (hcover : ∀ y ∈ frontier (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p),
      ∃ Φ : PartialDiffeomorph ((𝓘(ℝ, V)).prod (𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)))
          (𝓘(ℝ, V × ℝ)) (X × ℝ) N ∞,
        Φ.source = (univ : Set X) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Φ.source, Φ z ∈ C ↔ z.2 ≤ 0) ∧ ∃ x : X, Φ (x, 0) = y) :
    frontier (closure (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p)) = frontier (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p) ∧
    connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p = interior (closure (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p)) :=
/- SWARM_PROOF_BEGIN -/
by
  sorry
/- SWARM_PROOF_END -/
end PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
hint: Use collarRestriction_isOpenEmbedding to convert each Φ into an actual normalized collar. The existing DomainAtlas.oneSidedCollar_center_mem_frontier_closure works for any preconnected X. Derive frontier D subset frontier(closure D) by covering; reverse inclusion is frontier_closure_subset. Closed C makes component D open via LocallyConnectedSpace. Use regularOpen_of_frontier_closure_eq. Note no p-outside-C assumption is needed; the empty component is handled correctly.

import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar.Core
import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar.InteriorModel

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
open Set Function Manifold
open scoped Manifold ContDiff Topology

/-- Smooth models at boundary points suffice: interior models are constructed, not assumed. -/
theorem exists_smoothClosedDomain_of_boundary_models
    {E H N : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [TopologicalSpace H] [TopologicalSpace N] [ChartedSpace E N]
    [IsManifold (𝓘(ℝ, E)) ∞ N] (I : ModelWithCorners ℝ E H)
    {K : Set N} (hK : IsClosed K)
    (hboundary : ∀ y ∈ frontier K, ∃ e : OpenPartialHomeomorph N E,
      y ∈ e.source ∧ e ∈ IsManifold.maximalAtlas (𝓘(ℝ, E)) ∞ N ∧ e.IsImage K (range I)) :
    ∃ cs : ChartedSpace H K,
      letI : ChartedSpace H K := cs
      IsManifold I ∞ K ∧ IsSmoothEmbedding I (𝓘(ℝ, E)) ∞ (Subtype.val : K → N) ∧
      HasAmbientModelCharts I K ∧ (Subtype.val : K → N) '' I.boundary K = frontier K :=
/- SWARM_PROOF_BEGIN -/
by
  sorry
/- SWARM_PROOF_END -/
end PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
hint: Apply DomainAtlas.exists_smoothClosedDomain_structure. For each p:K split p.val ∈ interior K; use integrated interior_point_has_ambient_model. Otherwise p is in frontier K because K is closed. Use hboundary. Do not assume smooth structure on K as input.

import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar.Core
import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar.BoundaryModel
import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar.RegularOpenCover
import PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar.BoundaryToGlobal

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
open Set Function Manifold
open scoped Manifold ContDiff Topology

/-- Construct the actual complementary closure as a smooth domain from a covering
of its frontier by genuine smooth one-sided full collars. No closure atlas or
ambient local-set-model assumption is supplied separately. -/
theorem exists_smoothClosure_of_smoothCollar_cover {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
    {X N : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace N]
    [ChartedSpace V X] [ChartedSpace (V × ℝ) N]
    [IsManifold (𝓘(ℝ, V)) ∞ X] [IsManifold (𝓘(ℝ, V × ℝ)) ∞ N] [PreconnectedSpace X] [LocallyConnectedSpace N]
    {C : Set N} (hC : IsClosed C) {p : N}
    (hcover : ∀ y ∈ frontier (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p),
      ∃ Φ : PartialDiffeomorph ((𝓘(ℝ, V)).prod (𝓘(ℝ, ℝ)))
          (𝓘(ℝ, V × ℝ)) (X × ℝ) N ∞,
        Φ.source = (univ : Set X) ×ˢ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 ∧
        (∀ z ∈ Φ.source, Φ z ∈ C ↔ z.2 ≤ 0) ∧ ∃ x : X, Φ (x, 0) = y) :
    ∃ cs : ChartedSpace (HalfSpace V) (closure (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p)),
      letI : ChartedSpace (HalfSpace V) (closure (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p)) := cs
      IsManifold (halfSpaceModel V) ∞ (closure (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p)) ∧
      IsSmoothEmbedding (halfSpaceModel V) (𝓘(ℝ, V × ℝ)) ∞
        (Subtype.val : closure (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p) → N) ∧
      (Subtype.val : closure (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p) → N) ''
        (halfSpaceModel V).boundary (closure (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p)) =
          frontier (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p) ∧
      connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p = interior (closure (connectedComponentIn Cᶜ p)) :=
/- SWARM_PROOF_BEGIN -/
by
  sorry
/- SWARM_PROOF_END -/
end PoincareConjecture.Topology.FiberSaturation.SmoothCollar
hint: Combine smoothCollar_cover_regularOpen, smoothCollar_center_has_ambient_model and exists_smoothClosedDomain_of_boundary_models. Build boundary models at frontier(closure D) using the derived frontier equality and hcover; then construct cs and transport the intrinsic-boundary equality from frontier(closure D) to frontier D. Preserve all original ambient and cross-section structures. This theorem MUST NOT claim construction of the supplied smooth collars themselves.
